meta.description:
[accent[]]MobileConsole v1.0 - Developer Tools for Mobile Players[[]]
[white[]]📱 Full console access on your phone or tablet![[]]
[yellow[]]⚠️ This mod is specifically designed for mobile devices where console features are normally unavailable.[[]]
[red[]]⚠️ SINGLE-PLAYER ONLY - This mod does not work in multiplayer![[]]
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[red[]]⚠️ IMPORTANT DISCLAIMERS:[[]]
[yellow[]]• Not all commands may work on every device or game version[[]]
[yellow[]]• Commands only work in single-player mode[[]]
[yellow[]]• Building commands require appropriate permissions[[]]
[yellow[]]• Use at your own risk - some commands may affect game performance[[]]
[yellow[]]• This mod is in active development - bugs may occur[[]]
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[gold[]]📋 What Is This?[[]]
MobileConsole brings developer tools to your mobile device. Build, spawn, modify, and control your game with over 20 commands optimized for touch screens.
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[cyan[]]🎮 How to Access:[[]]
[white[]]In-Game:[[]]
• Type [cyan[]]/customhelp[[]] in chat to see all commands
• Type [cyan[]]/chelp[[]] for console system help
[white[]]Settings Menu:[[]]
• Open Settings → Developer Console
• Tap [cyan[]]Open Console[[]] button
[white[]]Quick Commands:[[]]
• Type any command in chat starting with /
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[lime[]]🏗️ Building Commands:[[]]
[cyan[]]/wallcore [type][[]] - Builds walls around your core
[cyan[]]/fill     [[]] - Fill area with blocks
[cyan[]]/clear [radius][[]] - Clear buildings around position
[cyan[]]/conveyor    [[]] - Build conveyor lines
[cyan[]]/powerline    [[]] - Create power connections
[cyan[]]/wallline     [type][[]] - Draw wall lines
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[yellow[]]🔧 Modification Commands:[[]]
[cyan[]]/upgrade  [[]] - Upgrade building types
[cyan[]]/replace  [[]] - Replace blocks
[cyan[]]/toggle [block][[]] - Enable/disable buildings
[cyan[]]/repair[[]] - Repair all damaged buildings
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[royal[]]⚔️ Unit Commands:[[]]
[cyan[]]/spawn   [x] [y][[]] - Spawn units
[cyan[]]/healunits[[]] - Restore all friendly units to full health
[cyan[]]/rally[[]] - Command units to your position
[cyan[]]/killenemies [radius][[]] - Eliminate enemies
[cyan[]]/units[[]] - Display unit statistics
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[cyan[]]⚡ Quick Actions:[[]]
[cyan[]]/turrets[[]] - Toggle all turrets
[cyan[]]/power[[]] - Display power grid statistics
[cyan[]]/resources[[]] - Check core resources
[cyan[]]/screenshot[[]] - Take clean screenshot
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[lime[]]🖥️ Console System:[[]]
[cyan[]]/chelp[[]] - Show console help
[cyan[]]/clear[[]] - Clear console logs
[cyan[]]/scan[[]] - Scan for available commands
[cyan[]]/stats[[]] - Show console statistics
[cyan[]]/commands[[]] - List all detected commands
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[gold[]]🎯 Features:[[]]
• Command history (last 50 commands)
• Favorites system
• Log management (1,500 entries)
• Search and filter functionality
• Touch-optimized interface
• Color-coded logs
• Mod management system
[accent[]]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[[]]
[white[]]Type [cyan[]]/customhelp[[]] in chat or open Settings → Developer Console to start![[]]
[yellow[]]Report issues on GitHub: github.com/SamielXD/MobileConsole[[]]
[white[]]- SamielXD[[]]
